a.prompt:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

Strict side view for a 2D side-scrolling game, the camera is level with the ground (not from above). Characters face RIGHT.
Tiles and background layers marked "connect seamlessly" must match exactly at the LEFT and RIGHT edges so they can repeat.
Mid layers: draw only the lower part, leave the upper part empty flat #FF00FF magenta.

BOGLE: a small round porcelain TEAPOT whose whole body IS the teapot (no human torso, no head sitting on a body).
Cream-white body #FBF6EA with one blue band #3E6DB5 around the middle and a row of small blue dots on the band.
Red #D2463C lid knob on top like a tiny hat. Short spout on the front-right, curved handle on the back.
Face on the front of the teapot: two big pie-cut eyes, rosy cheeks, wide friendly smile.
Two short rubber hose legs with big red round shoes, two rubber hose arms with white gloves coming out of the sides.
Proportions: teapot body 70% of total height, legs 30%.

One landscape 2-row sprite sheet, six separate full-body figures. TOP ROW exactly FOUR BOGLE running frames evenly spaced left to right; BOTTOM ROW exactly TWO BOGLE dashing frames below columns 1 and 3. Ample clean magenta margins and gaps, including between rows. Each figure at least 300 pixels high, use a large high-resolution canvas. Reading order is row-major. Run 1 and 3 noticeably squat and wide, run 2 and 4 noticeably stretched tall. Alternating near/far leg positions and arm swings create a real four-frame run cycle, feet remain rubber hose curves. Dash 1 and 2 have identical body size, tilt, lid position and vertical level, with perfectly straight scissor legs exchanging near/far positions. Their bodies lean forward rigidly without bounce or steam. Match the existing side-view BOGLE outline and proportions.

BOGLE running to the RIGHT in strict side view, wide bouncy rubber hose stride, front leg reaching, body squashed down, lid bouncing
BOGLE running to the RIGHT in strict side view, legs passing, body stretched up, lid lifted
BOGLE running to the RIGHT in strict side view, the other leg reaching forward, body squashed down
BOGLE running to the RIGHT in strict side view, legs passing again, body stretched up, small steam puff from spout
BOGLE dashing to the RIGHT in strict side view with a small grey battery pack clipped on his back, body rigid and leaning forward, legs straight like scissors, NO bounce, NO steam, eyes as two small glowing dots
the same rigid dashing BOGLE with the battery pack, legs swapped, body exactly level

Use case: illustration-story. Production game sprite sheet. Reference 1 is the approved style and palette anchor; reference 2 is linework only, never copy its character, lettering or shadow; references 3 and 4 are the exact existing BOGLE identity to preserve. No labels or panel borders. All figures face strictly RIGHT at ground-level camera. Spout points right, loop handle behind on left. Same porcelain body, same blue stripes and dots, red lid knob, red shoes as existing BOGLE. Plain pure #FF00FF magenta everywhere between and inside gaps. Flat cel coloring, no texture or gradients. Do not draw a separate humanoid torso. Battery pack is a small plain cool grey #9BA3AE rectangular casing with a strap clip and one tiny orange indicator, no logo or text. This pack design must match across all battery poses. Battery dash eyes override normal pie-cut eyes: exactly two small luminous dots. No ground or ground shadow.
